meaning:
ἐκ-στρέφω
[in LXX: Deu.32:20, Amo.6:13 Eze.16:34 A (הָפַךְ), Za 11:16 (פָּרַק pi.), Eze.13:20 (צוּד pi.)* ;]
1. to turn out of (Hom.).
2. to turn inside out; metaphorically, to change entirely, pervert (Aristoph.): Tit.3:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: knowing that such a one is perverted and sins, being self-condemned.
